# [EPIC] Core Microservices

## Epic
Implement the platform's core business microservices — Movie, User, and Actor — with real TMDB-backed data, persisted storage, and tested REST APIs, plus the cross-service integration tests and SonarQube quality gate that prove they work together.

## Business Value
Delivers the platform's core functionality: movie discovery, user accounts with favorites/watchlist, and actor/cast details — the foundation the rest of the backend and the frontend build on.

## Product Goal alignment
Serves the [Product Goal](../../docs/process/PRODUCT_GOAL.md) directly — this is the backend's core domain layer for the self-hosted, TMDB-shaped microservices platform.

## Notes
Stack: Spring Boot 3.5 across all three services — MongoDB + Redis (movie-service), PostgreSQL + JWT/Spring Security (user-service), PostgreSQL (actor-service). Full detail lives in the child Stories and their Tasks, not here.
